name: @clawdevbox/plugin-ado
description: Azure DevOps plugin for Clawdevbox — recipes, skills, triggers, and hostable tools (spec §10.3) for ADO PRs and work items. The hostable tools under `tools/` import `zod` and `@clawdevbox/sdk`; this package.json declares those deps so plugin.install can run `npm install` in the plugin directory after the clone/copy step. For the sample workspaces shipped here, the test harnesses link the Clawdevbox server's node_modules into the workspace root so resolution works without a per-plugin install.
